why: V4.1 Flash economics: cache-hit input << miss. Prefix stability = gross margin.
rules: Byte-freeze system prefix across all Flash calls of the same role
Put variable document AFTER prefix, never before
Do not timestamp the system prefix
Do not inject operator chat into prefix
Batch i18n of many slugs in one conversation with same prefix
KV key cls:{sha256(nfkc_lower_text)} stores type+sector+lang+ccy hints
KV key fact:{slug} stores claims pack; i18n reads it, never re-facts
CF Cache-Control on GET /api/radar/*.json: public, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=600
HTML SSR pages: edge cache + HTML rewriter; do not wait on Flash
Promote does not purge homepage cache until verify_table green
Off-peak bulk i18n window: 16:00-22:00 Asia/Shanghai when possible
